templates.why_chosen: Star, medium-confidence layered exemplar of the rare bottom-up direction, stacking a Transformer block from Input Token through self-attention into a Mixture-of-Experts block whose router fans dashed arrows to every expert but bolds the taken path.
templates.what_to_learn: When the tiers are literally computation layers of one repeated block, read them bottom-up with input at the floor and output at the ceiling, show repetition with a few offset background rectangles rather than N boxes, and distinguish a router's considered-but-not-taken paths, dashed, from its actual path, bold solid, in one colour.

templates.why_chosen: Medium-confidence nested-stack exemplar reading bottom-up: an outer Transformer box nests the Mixture-of-Experts feed-forward block, which itself nests a Router and its expert FFN boxes, three levels deep, with a stacked background implying repetition.
templates.what_to_learn: Nest a sparse sub-block, router plus experts, one level inside the standard block it replaces so the substitution is visible as containment, and show which inner sibling was actually chosen with a bold solid arrow while untaken siblings keep only a dashed candidate arrow.

templates.why_chosen: Two nested replication devices in one block: FFN 1, FFN 2, ellipsis, FFN N sit inside the MoE layer, while pale-yellow shaded layers stacked behind the whole block imply N repeated Transformer layers.
templates.what_to_learn: Nest two replication scales in one figure: an in-line ellipsis row (FFN 1, FFN 2, ..., FFN N) for experts inside a layer, and a background shadow stack for the layer itself repeating N times, then use dashed-vs-bold arrows from the router to show which single expert one example token actually takes.
